data_sources.name: ec_jrc_edgar
data_sources.label: EDGAR v8.1 air-pollutant inventory
data_sources.description: Pinned EDGAR v8.1 FT2022 AP inventory, nine adapter-listed air pollutants. Excludes large-scale biomass burning and LULUCF. Primary PM emissions are not ambient concentrations or secondary particulate formation. SO2 shipping was revised in November 2024; retrieve current corrected files and retain per-file checksums. No methods-paper DOI is asserted as a dataset DOI. Workbook I14 says CC BY 4.0, but the inspected release headers refer to conditions URLs without naming a verified SPDX license. The inventory assertion is preserved in the audit; license_spdx is left unset pending release-specific confirmation.
data_sources.citation_apa: European Commission, Joint Research Centre. EDGAR v8.1 global air pollutant emissions, 1970–2022. https://edgar.jrc.ec.europa.eu/dataset_ap81. Follow the provider how-to-cite and attribution conditions.

products.name: edgar_v81_bc_annual_totals_emi
products.label: EDGAR v8.1 BC annual TOTALS emi
products.description: All-sector annual totals delivery, 1970–2022. The 2022 original file for this exact species/output was inspected. Emissions are tonnes per cell for the named year; fluxes are kg/m2/s. These are distinct products and cannot use the same polygon reduction. calculate_edgar currently hardcodes a mean: that is not a polygon total for cell mass. A total needs clipped cell-mass allocation; a flux integral needs cell areas and verified time support, not an assumed 365-day multiplier. No monthly/sector-specific scale is copied from this profile. Global coordinate centres are verified, but the file has no explicit datum authority: GDAL CRS84 is an interpretation, not provider datum evidence. AMADEUS:100007 is an unresolved required-slot placeholder; no geometry execution is certified.
products.spatial_extent_descriptor: Global inventory grid; excluded sources and missing values remain qualified
